# Change Video Speed

- Route: `/tools/change-video-speed`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `change-video-speed`

## Summary

Make a time-lapse at 2x, 4x or faster, or slow a clip to 0.5x or 0.25x, with the audio kept in sync. (Video tools)

## Details

A screen recording that drags, a sunset that needs to be a ten-second time-lapse, a skateboard trick that deserves slow motion: changing playback speed is one of the most common video edits, and it should not need a desktop editor. Media Manipulator re-times both the picture and the sound on our servers with FFmpeg, from a quarter speed to four times speed, and exports an MP4 that plays at the new pace everywhere.
### What it does
- Speeds up (1.25x to 4x) or slows down (0.25x to 0.9x) any video.
- Re-times the audio with pitch-preserving tempo scaling so voices stay natural.
- Keeps resolution and quality; exports MP4 by default or any supported container.
- Combine with trim, resize or colour adjustments in the same pass.
### How to use it
1. Upload your video: Any common video format.
2. Set the speed: 0.25x to 4x; 2x is preselected.
3. Convert: FFmpeg re-times video and audio.
4. Download: Save the new MP4.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v, flv, wmv
- Output: mp4, webm, mov, mkv, gif
### Technical details
- Video uses setpts to scale presentation timestamps; audio uses atempo, chained for factors outside 0.5 to 2.0.
- Slowing down does not invent frames; for smooth slow motion use AI frame interpolation after slowing the clip.
- The frame rate is preserved, so a 4x time-lapse has a quarter of the original frames.
### Use cases
- Time-lapse: Compress an hour of building, cooking or painting into minutes.
- Slow motion: Slow a sports or pet clip to half speed.
- Faster tutorial: Speed up a screen recording without chipmunk audio.
- Match a music track: Nudge a clip to 1.1x to fit a beat.
### FAQ
Q: Does the audio stay in sync?
A: Yes. The audio is tempo-scaled by the same factor, with the pitch preserved.
Q: What is the maximum speed?
A: 4x faster and 0.25x slower in one pass. For more, run the result through the tool again.
Q: Will slow motion look smooth?
A: Slowing down repeats frames. For true smooth slow motion, slow the clip here and then use AI frame interpolation.
Q: Can I mute the audio instead?
A: Yes, use the Remove audio from video tool first, or export as GIF which has no audio.
